title: Basis-Only Funding Is Not Dividend Fair: Settlement Design in Crypto Equity Perpetuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.22839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crypto venues increasingly list perpetual futures on equities and other real-world assets (RWAs), which trade continuously yet reference dividend-paying stocks: a long equity perpetual marked to the ex-dividend cash price bears the ex-dividend drop without receiving the dividend. We ask whether the premium-index funding architecture these venues run -- funding set from the contemporaneous basis $e_t=P_t-S_t$ rather than a carry target -- can replicate shareholder cash flows for traders entering and exiting at arbitrary times. It cannot. Funding serves two roles that coincide for non-dividend crypto assets but split apart for equities: basis control and settlement. translated_title: 仅基于基差的资金费率并非股息公平：加密股票永续合约的结算设计
translated_abstract: 加密交易平台日益上市股票及其他现实世界资产（RWA）的永续期货合约，这些合约连续交易但标的为派息股票：多头股票永续合约按除息现金价格进行盯市，承担了除息时的价格下跌却无法获得股息。我们探究这些平台所采用的溢价指数资金费率架构——资金费率由当期基差 $e_t=P_t-S_t$ 决定而非以持有收益为目标——能否在交易者任意时点进出时复制股东的现金流。答案是：不能。资金费率承担着两种职能：基差控制与结算，对于不派息的加密资产这两种职能恰好重合，但对于股票而言二者则相互分离。我们给出了公平资金费率恒等式，将时点公平性表述为一个最优停时条件，并刻画了基差何时构成公平目标的充分统计量。决定性的障碍来自测度论层面：可预测的股息是一个原子测度，而任何绝对连续的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了仅基于基差的溢价指数资金费率机制无法在股票永续合约中公平结算股息，因为可预测的股息在测度论意义上是一个原子，无法被绝对连续的资金费率过程复制，进而提出应将基差控制与结算两种职能分离，并给出公平资金费率恒等式与最优停时条件以指导股息公平的结算设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that basis-only premium-index funding cannot achieve dividend fairness in crypto equity perpetuals—since a predictable dividend is a measure-theoretic atom that no absolutely continuous funding process can replicate—and derives the fair-funding identity and optimal-stopping conditions, showing that basis control and settlement must be separated in settlement design.
